notes.title: Моль пожрала хоррор: Обзор Luto
notes.notes: Прошло уже 11 лет с момента релиза P.T., однако эта короткая, но пугающая демоверсия отмененной Silent Hills остается эталоном жанра. Каждый новый хоррор неизбежно сравнивают с работой Хидео Кодзимы, но спустя столько времени никому не удалось даже приблизиться к оригиналу.

notes.title: Luto is now available!
notes.notes: [p][b]Dear players,[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Luto is finally here![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We want to sincerely thank all of you who have patiently waited throughout this time. Your support and trust have meant a great deal to us. This project has been a long and personal journey, and knowing there were people waiting on the other side gave us the strength to keep going.[/p][p] [/p][p]And of course, we also want to thank those who are discovering us for the first time. Welcome![/p][p] [/p][p]This moment is very special to us. Luto is our first video game, and its development took longer than expected precisely because we started from scratch. Every step has been a challenge, but also a valuable learning experience.[/p][p] [/p][p]We truly hope you enjoy the game and can feel the effort and dedication we’ve poured into it![/p][p] [/p][p]Once again, thank you all so much…[/p][p][/p][p]- The Broken Bird Games Team.[/p]

notes.title: About SteamOS compatibility.
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We want to let you know that [b]Luto is currently not properly supported on SteamOS.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]While we're actively looking into the issues, we cannot guarantee the full experience on Steam Deck and other SteamOS consoles. Players may encounter graphical glitches, performance issues or crashes when trying to run the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We are working in an update that will be available soon. We will comunicate when it's ready on social media and here on Luto's community hub.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support and understanding as we continue to improve the game![/p][p][/p][p]- The Broken Bird Games team.[/p]

notes.title: We say goodbye to Luto Demo: The Choice on July 15
notes.notes: [p][b]Dear players[/b],[/p][p][/p][p][b]Luto Demo: The Choice[/b] was truly our first fully developed and published project, made for everyone to play. We learned a lot from it and we are very proud of the result.[/p][p][/p][p]We've always said that it's a standalone experience from Luto, and while that's true, those who played it will probably feel a certain sense of déjà vu at some point playing Luto, as it includes some references to the demo that won't go unnoticed.[/p][p][/p][p]That's why we want to let you know that the demo will end soon, so [b]if you haven't tried it yet, you still have time to do so until 15 July![/b][/p][p][/p][p]With that said, in response to the understandable question of why we’re removing the demo if it’s a standalone experience, we’d like to explain that it was created several years ago, and we no longer feel it represents the final version of Luto. Because of this, we don’t want it to be seen as a reflection of the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who played Luto Demo: The Choice. [b]We’ll see you on July 22![/b][/p][p][/p][p]- The Broken Bird Games team.[/p]

notes.title: Luto demo: The Choice now supports multiple Asian languages!
notes.notes:
To Asian players,

We are pleased to announce that the Luto demo: The Choice has been updated to support multiple Asian languages. The demo is now available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

Thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: Luto will also be available in Asia!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41520303/a43e24eade1aa6278c466d75641b6fbaecbdd922.png[/img]


[b]We are pleased to announce that we are joining forces with Astrolabe Games, who together with Selecta Play will take the distribution of Luto even further.[/b]

Thanks to this partnership, Luto will be released on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in Asia as well! Adding to the list of languages that will be available at launch the following:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese.
[*] Traditional Chinese.
[*] Korean.
[*] Japanese.
[/list]

Luto demo: The Choice will also be available in these languages very soon!

notes.title: Luto demo: The Choice now available on PlayStation 5!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41520303/5cf7f18fa9f52709edc4b79d4b8e5f78fe413fc5.png[/img]

[b]PlayStation 5 users can now also enjoy the Luto demo: The Choice![/b]

This demo represents part of what Luto will be, but it's also a standalone experience that can be enjoyed as a small game on its own - if you haven't played it yet, what are you waiting for?

Link [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP6326-PPSA18052_00-LUTODEMO00000000]here[/url].

notes.title: Luto is a psychological horror game about trying to get out of your house
notes.notes: Luto is a first-person psychological horror game about pain, loss, insecurity, and what happens to a person when he can't even leave his own home. It's set to come out later this year, and we got our first look at its disturbingly creepy world in a new trailer that appeared in today's Future Games Show... Read more.
